rules.statement: The RTL design must follow the VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2 (REF-003) as the mandatory coding, hierarchy, reset, CDC and naming baseline.
This specification must stay consistent with REF-001, REF-002 and REF-003.
REF-003 is the mandatory RTL coding baseline and the RTL must comply with it.

rules.condition: A write transfer with PSTRB other than 4'b1111
rules.statement: The bridge must reject a write with PSTRB other than 4'b1111 by responding with PSLVERR.
The bridge must reject a transfer with misaligned PADDR by responding with PSLVERR.
PPROT must be accepted and ignored; it must not affect bridge behavior.
The TL-UL host side must use a_size = 2 only, with 32-bit data and no bursts.
a_user must be driven to zero, with no integrity.
